sources.title: The language of play: Developing preschool vocabulary through play following shared book-reading
sources.usage: Design context only: an original preschool study of vocabulary supported by shared reading and adult-supported play. Its intervention is not this game.

parentTip.en: Point to a cat in a book; say “cat” and invite your child to point or make a quiet meow.
parentTip.vi: Chỉ vào con mèo trong sách, nói “cat” rồi mời bé chỉ tay hoặc kêu “meo” thật khẽ.

parentTip.en: Point to a dog in a picture, say “dog,” and invite your child to make a bark or point.
parentTip.vi: Chỉ vào hình con chó, nói “dog” rồi mời bé bắt chước tiếng gâu hoặc chỉ tay.

parentTip.en: Spread your arms like wings, say “bird,” and invite your child to flap along.
parentTip.vi: Dang tay làm cánh chim, nói “bird” rồi mời bé vẫy tay cùng.

parentTip.en: Move one hand like a swimming fish, say “fish,” and invite your child to copy.
parentTip.vi: Đưa bàn tay bơi như cá, nói “fish” rồi mời bé làm theo.

parentTip.en: Pretend to bite an apple, say “apple,” and invite your child to point or pretend to bite.
parentTip.vi: Giả vờ cắn quả táo, nói “apple” rồi mời bé chỉ tay hoặc giả vờ cắn.

parentTip.en: Pretend to peel a banana, say “banana,” and invite your child to copy the peeling motion.
parentTip.vi: Giả vờ bóc chuối, nói “banana” rồi mời bé cùng làm động tác bóc.

parentTip.en: Roll a soft ball, say “ball” as it moves, and invite your child to roll it back.
parentTip.vi: Lăn quả bóng mềm, nói “ball” khi bóng lăn rồi mời bé lăn lại.

parentTip.en: Touch a book cover, say “book,” and invite your child to turn a page with you.
parentTip.vi: Chạm nhẹ vào bìa sách, nói “book” rồi mời bé cùng lật một trang.

parentTip.en: Pretend to pour water into a cup, say “cup,” and invite a pretend sip.
parentTip.vi: Giả vờ rót nước vào cốc, nói “cup” rồi mời bé giả vờ nhấp một ngụm.

parentTip.en: Hold up a shoe, say “shoe,” and invite your child to point to their own shoe.
parentTip.vi: Cầm một chiếc giày, nói “shoe” rồi mời bé chỉ vào chiếc giày của mình.

parentTip.en: Point to a sun in a picture, say “sun,” and trace a big circle in the air together.
parentTip.vi: Chỉ vào hình mặt trời, nói “sun” rồi cùng vẽ một vòng tròn lớn trong không khí.

parentTip.en: Point to a star picture, say “star,” and wiggle your fingers to make a twinkle.
parentTip.vi: Chỉ vào hình ngôi sao, nói “star” rồi xòe ngón tay làm ánh sao lấp lánh.

limitations: This is a small set of concrete noun examples, not a complete vocabulary curriculum or a validated age band.

The pack has not been tested with children or families. Learning effectiveness, age suitability, accessibility, Vietnamese localization, and picture-choice performance are not established; it makes no CEFR or assessment claim.
Vietnamese usage varies by region and family. For example, some speakers use “cái ly” for “cup” and “trái táo” for “apple”; families may use other natural terms.

Use for adult-assisted, pre-reading play: an adult can read the cue and name each picture. Optional browser text-to-speech may have no suitable voice, sound different across devices, or be unavailable offline; a caregiver can read aloud instead.

If shown as a three-picture choice, use clear original drawings with one target and two visually distinct choices. Keep participation untimed and supportive; do not treat a selection as a score or proof of mastery.
The linked references inform general design choices only. Their guidance and study findings do not demonstrate the suitability or effectiveness of this pack or browser game.
